metadata.title: आदिवासी विकास मंत्री बिकास देबबर्मा इंटरव्यू | Interview with Bikash Debbarma | Main Bhi Bharat
metadata.description: In an exclusive interview with Main Bhi Bharat Editor Shyam Sunder in Agartala, Bikash Debbarma, Tripura's Minister of Tribal Welfare, shares his insights on tribal development under the BJP’s governance. Minister Debbarma claims that tribal development has significantly accelerated. Yet, he acknowledges the serious challenge posed by drug abuse among tribal youth—a concern impacting both the government and society at large. This in-depth discussion addresses critical issues facing Tripura's tribal communities.
